instruct students: Mr. Lin was hired to instruct students in basic first aid, such as how to stop bleeding.
林老師受聘教導學生基本急救，例如如何止血。
instruct someone to: Before the trip, the coach will instruct someone to show the new players, step by step, how to use the machines.
出發前，教練會指示某人一步一步地教新球員如何使用器材。
be instructed to wait: Visitors were politely instructed to wait in the lobby, and a staff member explained that the director would arrive soon.
訪客被客氣地告知在大廳等候，一位工作人員說明主任很快就會到。
instruct a lawyer: After the accident, the injured driver decided to instruct a lawyer to handle his claim against the insurance company.
事故發生後，受傷的駕駛決定委託律師處理他向保險公司提出的索賠。
insult one's intelligence: Please don't insult my intelligence with such a silly excuse; I know you simply forgot your homework.
請不要用這麼荒謬的藉口侮辱我的智商；我知道你只是忘了寫作業。
add insult to injury: My bike was stolen, and to add insult to injury, it started raining hard while I walked home.
我的腳踏車被偷了，更雪上加霜的是，我走路回家時開始下起大雨。
take something as an insult: In some cultures, people may take something as an insult if you refuse the food they offer you.
在某些文化中，如果你拒絕別人提供的食物，對方可能會將此視為侮辱。
integrate into society: Learning the local language is one of the best ways for newcomers to integrate into society quickly.
學習當地語言是新移民快速融入社會的最佳方法之一。
integrate technology into teaching: Many teachers now integrate technology into teaching by using tablets and online games in their classes.
現在許多老師在課堂上使用平板和線上遊戲，把科技融入教學。
integrate immigrants: The city offers free language classes and job training to help integrate immigrants into local communities.
市政府提供免費語言課程和職業訓練，幫助使移民融入當地社區。
integrated system: The hospital uses an integrated system that lets doctors see a patient's test results, medicine, and history in one place.
這家醫院使用一套整合系統，讓醫生能在同一處查看病人的檢查結果、用藥與病史。
intend to leave: I intend to leave the party early tonight because I have to catch the first train tomorrow morning.
我打算今晚提早離開派對，因為明天早上我得趕搭第一班火車。
be intended for children: The colorful picture books on this shelf are intended for children between the ages of three and six.
這個書架上色彩繽紛的圖畫書是專為三到六歲的兒童設計的。
intend no harm: "I intend no harm," the stranger said softly, putting down his bag so the frightened children would not run away.
「我無意傷害你們，」陌生人輕聲說，並放下袋子，好讓受驚的孩子們不會跑走。
as intended: Thanks to careful planning, the school festival ran smoothly as intended, and everyone had a wonderful time.
多虧周詳的規劃，校慶如預期般順利進行，每個人都玩得很開心。
intensify efforts: After more students failed the test, the school decided to intensify efforts to offer extra help after class.
在更多學生考試不及格之後，學校決定加緊努力，提供課後額外輔導。
the conflict intensified: When neither side was willing to compromise, the conflict intensified and the workers went on strike.
當雙方都不願意妥協時，衝突加劇，工人們開始罷工。
intensify pressure: Rising prices will only intensify pressure on families who are already struggling to pay their rent.
物價上漲只會加大那些已經難以支付房租的家庭所承受的壓力。
the storm intensified: As the night went on, the storm intensified, and strong winds knocked down trees all over the city.
隨著夜深，風暴增強，強風吹倒了全市各地的樹木。
interact with customers: Working at the front desk, Amy has to interact with customers politely, even when they are angry.
在櫃檯工作的艾美必須有禮貌地與顧客互動，即使他們很生氣也一樣。
interact with the environment: In this science class, we study how plants and animals interact with the environment around them.
在這堂自然課中，我們研究植物和動物如何與周圍環境交互作用。
drugs interact: Always tell your doctor what medicine you take, because some drugs interact and can cause dangerous side effects.
務必告訴醫生你正在服用什麼藥，因為有些藥物會交互作用，可能引起危險的副作用。
interfere with one's work: Loud music from the neighbors' apartment began to interfere with my work, so I moved to the library.
鄰居公寓傳來的吵雜音樂開始妨礙我的工作，所以我改到圖書館去。
interfere in one's affairs: My aunt always tries to interfere in my affairs, telling me what to study and whom to date.
我阿姨總是想干涉我的事務，告訴我該讀什麼、該跟誰交往。
interfere with the signal: Passengers are asked to turn off their phones because they may interfere with the signal used by the pilots.
乘客被要求關閉手機，因為手機可能會干擾機師所使用的訊號。
interfere in an election: Several countries were accused of trying to interfere in an election by spreading fake news online.
有好幾個國家被指控企圖透過在網路上散布假新聞來干預選舉。
interpret the data: Scientists need more time to interpret the data before they can say what caused the rise in temperature.
科學家需要更多時間解讀數據，才能說明造成溫度上升的原因。
interpret a dream: In ancient times, people often asked wise men to interpret a dream that seemed to predict the future.
在古代，人們常請智者解讀似乎預示未來的夢。
interpret for a visitor: Since Mary speaks fluent Japanese, she was asked to interpret for a visitor from Tokyo during the meeting.
由於瑪莉說得一口流利的日語，她被請來在會議中為一位來自東京的訪客口譯。
interpret the law: It is the job of judges to interpret the law fairly when people disagree about what it means.
當人們對法律的意義有不同看法時，法官的職責就是公正地解釋法律。
interpret as a threat: The dog may interpret your sudden movements as a threat, so stay calm and walk away slowly.
那隻狗可能會把你突然的動作解讀為威脅，所以要保持冷靜，慢慢走開。
